Based on: E-512

Buyer:
Good day,
We want to order 8 boxes of linen napkins at $25 per box.
Can you do a 15% discount and also give us free shipping?

Seller:
Good day,
We can supply 8 boxes at $25 each, but we cannot afford a 15% discount.
We can offer free shipping on this order if payment is made upon receipt.

Buyer:
Okay, we will skip the discount and take the free shipping on 8 boxes at $25.
Please send the invoice.
